findings: Recommendation calibration cases correctly map user needs to allowed outcomes without fabricating adoption or certification.
Example recommendation package explicitly marks adoption_evidence as INTERNAL_SYNTHETIC_ONLY and lists limitations including 'not publicly launched'.
Pilot results show 100% precision, abstention accuracy, and non-fit rejection accuracy for recommendation tasks, meeting all defined thresholds.
Recommendation reason codes and status align with fit/non-fit criteria and verified capabilities without overclaiming maturity.
Pilot limitations section correctly identifies that local synthetic pilot is not external adoption or public discovery.
No authority violations or semantic elevation findings recorded, maintaining boundary between recommendation and decision.
optional_suggestions: Consider adding a calibration case for 'NOT_APPLICABLE' status to ensure full coverage of allowed outcomes.
Document the specific evaluation methodology used to achieve 100% recommendation precision in the pilot report.
Add explicit mapping between recommendation reason codes and the fit/non-fit criteria in the schema documentation.
uncertainty: Long-term human intervention target of 0.01 is not yet met (current rate 0.0833), which may affect recommendation reliability in production scenarios.
Single model lineage (qwen3.7-max) used across all sessions limits generalizability of recommendation calibration results.
Zero outcome improvement rate in frozen value-gate fixture suggests recommendation system may not yet demonstrate value-add in complex scenarios.
limitations: Review based on controlled pilot artifacts only; no external adoption evidence or production deployment data available.
Recommendation calibration tested with only 4 synthetic cases; real-world user needs may present edge cases not covered.
Pilot participant count of 7 with single model lineage limits statistical confidence in recommendation metrics.
No independent verification of recommendation precision claims beyond self-reported pilot results.
